capabilities: Clean selected text or entire notes with a toggleable cleaner pipeline
Fix copied PDF line breaks and hyphenated word splits
Convert lines into bullet, numbered, and checklist lists or wiki and Markdown links
Sort lines and headings alphabetically and remove duplicate lines
Insert date wiki links from @ suggestions like @today and @nextweek
extras: Runs fully locally with no network requests or accounts; no default hotkeys are registered, so users must assign their own. Whole-note cleanup can make broad changes, and the README advises testing the pipeline on a small selection first.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for cleaning pasted or messy text, such as fixing PDF line wrapping, removing duplicate lines, normalizing list and heading spacing, or sorting lines.
summary: Text cleanup toolkit that turns messy selected text or whole notes into clean Markdown via commands, a configurable pipeline, and @ date suggestions.
